Hi Naomi / Kimberly,

Attached is our latest set of redlines to the MSA and Order Form. Two items we need to lock down before final sign:

1) The customer-side preferred flow for third-party IP claims: we (Althea) want right-to-defend but need confirmation on how evidence custody and remediation timelines are handed off between legal and engineering teams.

Kimberly / Ben — looping you both in with Althea's ask. High level thoughts before legal digs in:

- We should avoid full "right to defend" transfer where possible; propose hybrid: Redwood retains right to control defense for third-party IP claims but agrees to transfer control if we opt out (with customer cooperation and cost recovery mechanics).
- For operational sequencing: legal >> CSM (or Partner Ops) >> engineering evidence collection. Legal should always be first touched to gate privilege and litigation risk.
- Evidence custody: propose a short template (attach) that lists technical artifacts we will request (call stacks, sample inputs, model version, KV cache snapshot where applicable).

Kimberly, can you produce 1-page decision memo and a suggested redline for the defense-control paragraph? Ben — need your take on how this would affect procurement cadence and whether Sales can commit to the evidence SLA.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman

Naomi / team — draft attached (redwood_indemnity_proposal_2027-12-06.pdf) with the following recommended compromise:

- Defense control: Redwood will accept customer defense control for claims directly arising from customer's modification/distribution of outputs, otherwise Redwood will defend. If customer requests control and Redwood declines, customer may retain external counsel at its expense and Redwood will continue to participate.
- Notice and evidence: Customer must provide initial notice within 30 days of becoming aware (we can negotiate shorter for high-risk sectors). Once notice is received, CSM/Legal triage within 3 business days; engineering evidence pull within 5 business days (subject to redaction and privilege review).
- Preservation: include an "evidence-preservation" attachment to the Order Form (see attached template).

These timeboxes are tight but necessary for rapid triage. If Sales thinks 3/5 day SLAs break deals, propose alternatives.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
